name.description: Config key; must equal the file name.

url.description: Start URL of a single-site app (legacy; normalized to one source). Use `sources` for several.

name.description: Display name (the only thing shown in the UI).

url.description: Start URL (never shown in the UI).

allowedHosts.description: Default: URL host and its subdomains.

accent.description: Accent colour; a palette colour is picked by index when missing.

credit.description: Author credit shown on the splash.

remote.description: Firebase Remote Config live config; omit to build without Firebase.

googleServices.description: Path to google-services.json, relative to the repo root.

template.description: Path to the Remote Config JSON source.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts allowed for in-app top-level navigation. Default: URL host and its subdomains.

authHosts.description: Extra sign-in hosts (added to the built-in list) that a user tap may open as a top-level navigation.

dohHosts.description: Hosts whose requests are answered over DNS-over-HTTPS, for networks whose resolver poisons a name the site depends on.

externalLinks.description: Non-allowed hosts: "block" (default, silently ignored) or "in-app". "open-external" is deprecated and treated as "block"; the app never launches other apps.

userAgent.description: null = platform default with WebView markers removed.

lists.description: "default" or an array of filter list URLs.

blockPopups.description: Block window.open / target=_blank to non-allowed hosts.

tvProfiles.description: Per-source TV navigation profiles (selectors only); overridable from Remote Config.

notes.description: Free text for humans; ignored by the app.

header.description: Hidden after 5 s idle, shown on input.

rows.description: Horizontal carousels (LEFT/RIGHT inside, UP/DOWN between rows).

skip.description: Never focused (rail arrows, dots, floating buttons).

firstFocus.description: First focus on page load (hero Play), in priority order.

playButtons.description: Elements that start playback: trigger auto-fullscreen.

toggle.description: Button that opens the site server picker.

failed.description: Entry or banner shown when a server is dead.

frame.description: Iframe holding the picker when it is not in the page itself.

fullscreenButton.description: The site's own fullscreen toggles, hidden with CSS on TV.

controls.description: Player control bars hidden on idle.

overlayKill.description: Intro layers and ad overlays in front of the player, hidden.

depth.description: Iframe nesting depth of the real <video> (0 = same document).

killOnTv.description: Heavy decorative media removed on TV (autoplaying trailer iframes).

viewportWidth.description: CSS px layout width on TV; default 1280, a site may opt out with 960.

cache.description: Disk asset cache (images, fonts, versioned static files); on by default for tv only.

enabled.description: Default: on for the tv target, off elsewhere.
